description: This file defines the RepoUpdateManager class and related classes for managing repository updates in an Android app, including update logic, progress tracking, and notifications.

classes.name: RepoUpdateManager
classes.description: Manages repository updates, including scheduling, executing updates, and notifying progress.

classes.name: RepoUpdateListener
classes.description: Listens to update progress and completion events, manages notification updates.

classes.name: RepoUpdateProgress
classes.description: Represents ongoing progress of a repository update, including download and insertion phases.

classes.name: RepoUpdateFinished
classes.description: Represents the completion state of a repository update with the result.

methods.name: updateRepos
methods.description: Performs an update of all enabled repositories, respecting timing constraints and updating notifications.

methods.name: updateRepo
methods.description: Updates a specific repository by ID, with progress notifications and result reporting.

methods.name: onUpdateStarted
methods.description: Called when a repository update begins, updates internal state.

methods.name: onDownloadProgress
methods.description: Handles download progress updates, updates notifications and internal state.

methods.name: onUpdateProgress
methods.description: Handles progress of app data saving during update, updates notifications.

methods.name: onUpdateFinished
methods.description: Called when a repository update finishes, updates internal state.

methods.name: getPercent
methods.description: Calculates percentage progress based on current and total bytes or apps.
